presentation_goal: Showcase GuardianWing's core technology stack and engineering feasibility for project review and submission.
audience: Project judges, academic reviewers, and technical stakeholders evaluating the GuardianWing smart walker system.
theme_style: Clean technical blue theme, light background with teal-to-blue gradient accents, professional and academic feel.

visual_system.background_strategy: Light off-white background (#f8fafc) with subtle grid texture. Header and bottom bar use teal-to-blue gradients. Consistent with GuardianWing's brand colors.
visual_system.motif: Three-column table layout (Technology | Principle | Outcomes) with rounded card rows. Each row uses a colored left accent bar. Circular icon backgrounds for technology items.

color_roles.primary: Teal (#0d9488) - used for Technology column header and accents
color_roles.secondary: Blue (#3b82f6) - used for Principle and Outcomes headers
color_roles.accent: Dark blue (#1e3a5f) - used for title and conclusion bar

typography_constraints.long_text_handling: Split technology descriptions into short bullets. Keep metric values as bold numbers with short labels.

slides.title: Core Technologies & Feasibility
slides.key_message: GuardianWing's 5-core technology stack demonstrates technical feasibility and engineering readiness for real-world deployment.
slides.visual_focus: Three-column table with 5 technology rows, each combining icon, description, principle visualization, and outcome metrics. The middle principle column uses whiteboard diagrams (line chart, face icons, satellite positioning, dashboard, flow diagram).

asset_need.purpose: Show multi-sensor fusion data comparison in Principle column row 1
asset_need.fallback_if_missing: Use whiteboard SVG line chart with 4 colored series (IMU, Force, Encoder, Fusion) and axis labels

asset_need.purpose: Face-state recognition emotion icons in Principle column row 2
asset_need.fallback_if_missing: Use 4 circular face icons (Neutral, Smile, Fatigue, Distress) drawn as whiteboard SVG

asset_need.purpose: BeiDou + SparkLink positioning diagram in Principle column row 3
asset_need.fallback_if_missing: Whiteboard SVG showing satellite icons, walker device, location pin with dashed connection lines

asset_need.purpose: Dashboard data visualization mockup in Principle column row 4
asset_need.fallback_if_missing: Whiteboard SVG with 3 metric cards (Gait Score, Heart Rate, Alert) and small line charts

asset_need.purpose: Dual-channel monitoring flow in Principle column row 5
asset_need.fallback_if_missing: Whiteboard Mermaid flowchart showing Hardware Monitoring -> Decision Fusion -> AI Monitoring with Alert escalation path

slides.speaker_intent: Demonstrate technical depth across all five modules while proving each has measurable outcomes and real-world validation.
